title: Origin story: Hel
description: Hel was the daughter of Loki and the giantess Angrboda, cast by Odin into Niflheim to rule those who died of sickness and old age rather than battle. Half her body is the blue-black of a corpse, half the fairness of a living woman, and her hall is called Damp-with-Sleet.

title: Ability profile: Hel
description: Ranked abilities: Command of the dead — rank 100/100; Implacability — rank 98/100; Patience — rank 97/100; Cold endurance — rank 96/100; Judgment — rank 90/100.

title: Power ranking: Hel
description: Powers: Authority over all who die straw-deaths; A gaze half corpse, half living; The ship Naglfar, built from dead men's nails.

title: Stamina feats: Hel
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Has ruled the cold dead since the world's youth; Waits in perfect patience for Ragnarok.

title: Crossover notes: Hel
description: Hel crosses naturally with: death, the dishonored dead, the underworld.

title: Cultural impact: Hel
description: Her name became the English word for the underworld.

title: Generator record: Hel
description: This record documents the boundless generator for Hel's database.
